goal: Change only the body wording so her body matches the reference's stocky cartoon raccoon (big round head, thick (not short) limbs, simple soft torso, mild waist) instead of lanky human pin-up proportions, with the same seeds (20261027, 4 images).
why: BASE: female-raccoon-001-teal-colour-wording (Josh: off-track, 'the body is too human'). ONE change: body wording. Removed (adult proportions:1.1), (narrow waist:1.1), (wide hips:1.1), full thighs, which probably pushed the lanky curvy pin-up build, and 'slender raccoon hands'. Added (cartoon animal proportions:1.3), (stocky:1.1), big round head, thick arms, (thick legs:1.1), simple soft torso, thick raccoon hands (thick but not short: the reference's legs are about 0.44 of her height), so the body follows the reference's stocky cartoon shape. Female read kept with (mild waist:1.1), (wider hips:1.1), (narrow shoulders:1.1), (adult woman), (female:1.4), eyelashes; (featureless body:1.3) and smooth fur body stay. Negative adds (human proportions:1.3), (thin legs:1.2), (thin arms:1.1), (lanky:1.2) (replacing long legs, so thin limbs are pushed away without asking for short ones), (pin-up:1.2), (detailed anatomy:1.2), (tall:1.1) to push away the human body. Butt/backside terms were NOT put in the negative: the style guide's known faults say anatomy words in the negative set off a censor mark on the lower back. COLOUR IS DELIBERATELY UNTOUCHED this round: the teal/turquoise wording, navy, pale-cyan words and colour negatives are identical to the base even though the fur overshot to sky blue, so the body change is judged on its own. IP-Adapter (baseline.jpg, 0.8), canny (baseline-highres.png, 0.6, end 0.6), LoRA, seeds, size, steps, CFG and sampler are unchanged. Judge body shape and proportions only.
